scope: Read-only recovery from pinned commit and previously verified detached review; no new research, proofs, compilation, Git mutation, or acceptance.

accepted_checklist.name: Conservative evidence-backed acceptance-checklist completion floor
accepted_checklist.formula: (22 retired originals +8 historically accepted Step3b wrappers +44 accepted Point1/additional roots +5 accepted Step3h obligations) /133
accepted_checklist.numerator_boundary: Original accepted checklist units only; no helper, input review or build unit.

acceptance_rule.original_obligation: Either recorded sound retirement as unused, or an implementation preserving the required statement, exact approval of admitted dependencies, proved nondefinitional project translations, and matching changed-module/reverse-dependency evidence. Current whole-graph certification is also required at GATE-02.
acceptance_rule.definitions: All eight named semantic validations remain separate; preserving identical operational definitions is not itself a proof that they match standard notions.
acceptance_rule.historical_boundary: The 22 Step 3a retirements and 8 Step 3b wrappers retain their recovered stage-acceptance credit. Current whole-source compilation is documented separately in latest_verified_full_graph; it does not itself re-audit their literature statements.
acceptance_rule.status_update_rule: Promote an individual unit only when its evidence meets the rule; do not infer closure from namespace, sorry count, helper compilation, or an unverified completion announcement.

denominator_basis.publication_audit_policy: Every original obligation includes the approval of all admitted dependencies it uses. Shared leaf reviews may serve several obligations but are not additional numerator/denominator units. Moving or splitting an admission never earns credit by itself.
denominator_basis.scope_revision_policy: Attach discovered subtasks to the governing original obligation, definition validation, or final gate. Change the fixed denominator only by an explicit recorded scope revision.
denominator_basis.supersedes: The earlier provisional 153-unit suggestion in TARGET_INTEGRATION.md double-counted 50 leaf reviews and is superseded by this 133-unit ledger.
denominator_basis.remaining_original_obligations_scope: Historical post-Step3b baseline (91); current pending original obligations42. Fixed denominator unchanged.

current_native_boundary.scope: Accepted 49-root boundary only; not an exhaustive acceptance audit of all remaining source admissions or the final theorem.
